primary.name: Health-Conscious Hannah
goals: Forgets to track habits throughout busy days
Loses motivation when progress is not visible
Too many complex health apps to manage
jobsToBeDone: When I train clients, I need to show my own results, so I can lead by example
When analyzing progress, I need detailed metrics, so I can adjust my approach
When planning workouts, I need historical data, so I can track what works

scenarios.title: First-Time User Onboarding
scenarios.context: New user downloads HydroTrack for the first time
steps: User opens app and sees splash screen with value proposition
User taps "Get Started" and sets up profile
User sets their first goal/target
User completes first action (e.g., Water logging)
User sees immediate feedback and progress
**Success Criteria**: User completes first action within 2 minutes
### Scenario 2: Daily Habit Tracking
**Context**: Returning user wants to Water logging
**Steps**:
User opens app to dashboard
User sees current progress/stats
User taps primary action button
User logs entry with minimal friction
User sees updated progress immediately
**Success Criteria**: Entry logged in under 10 seconds
### Scenario 3: Progress Review
**Context**: User wants to see how they're doing
**Steps**:
User navigates to history/analytics
User views trend charts and historical data
User identifies patterns or areas for improvement
User adjusts goals if needed

escapePoints: Fragmented tracking: Using multiple apps or paper logs that don't sync
Lost motivation: Progress invisible, no sense of achievement
Complexity fatigue: Overcomplicated apps with features they don't need
Inconsistency: Forgetting to track, losing streaks, feeling guilty
Data silos: Information locked in apps, no ownership or export
Simplicity: HydroTrack focuses on Water logging without bloat
Visual progress: See trends, streaks, and achievements immediately
Frictionless logging: Water logging in under 10 seconds
Ownership: All data stored locally, full privacy and control
Motivation: Positive reinforcement for consistency, gentle nudges for recovery
- Tracks Water logging daily for 30+ days
- Makes data-driven decisions about their health tracking
